I’ve seen debates online on whether Alice In Chains and soundgarden are metal or not, and some tend to not call them metal because Nirvana and Pearl Jam are grunge but not usually heavy. so I just came here to ask if grunge can be considered metal because it’s roots are pretty heavy, and alot of almost every grunge album outside of nevermind and pearl jam (yes, including bleach and in utero) are pretty heavy, so is it fair to call some grunge bands/songs metal? (specifically Alice In Chains and soundgarden)
